## Glossary

**apiTokens**  
Setting that opts in to API-key providers and the API decision provider (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); cannot combine with subscriptionOnly.

**assertMainThreadLabs**  
Throws unless every registered main thread runs on a main-thread lab.

**Cheap models for decisions**  
Classifiers, routers, Cartographer, Librarian and Wardens run Claude Haiku 5.5; only the Artificer uses a capable model by default.

**Codex worker CODEX_HOME**  
A Codex worker runs on a Foundry-private .foundry/runtime-profiles/<source id>/codex-home linking the profile's auth.json.

**defaults.nativeAuthenticationId**  
Optional explicit native-profile source for the worker; its runtime matches the worker.

**defaults.provider**  
The main-thread worker harness: claude-code (default) or codex without API tokens.

**FOUNDRY_STARTUP_SELF_TEST**  
Env flag (=1) that lets startup make a model call; in subscription mode it consumes a decision allowance.

**Integration limits**  
Local profile references are not Kingdom capacity grants; an execution contract must authorize roles, models and budgets itself.

**main thread**  
The default worker and every enabled executor; may run only on a main-thread lab.

**MAIN_THREAD_LABS**  
The five labs main threads may run on (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, xAI); others, gateways and local hosts are refused.

**native-profile source**  
A nativeAuthentication entry naming a private (0700) profile directory: a credential reference, never a token.

**refused setting**  
A setting subscription mode cannot enforce (non-subscription worker, decision agent with tools or temperature) is refused, not routed.

**resolveSubscriptionPolicy**  
Resolves subscription mode (default) versus API tokens, checking login locations at startup.

**routed agent**  
A non-executor agent saved with another provider or model, run on the decision profile at startup and listed in the startup log.

**shared holder**  
The worker and decisions may both hold one login, like the user's own concurrent CLI sessions.

**Subscription-only default**  
No API provider, no paid fallback, no automatic retry, no model substitution unless apiTokens is set.

**subscription-policy**  
Class: subscription-only by default, apiTokens opt-in, which login and model the worker and each role use, integration limits.

**subscriptionOnly.decisionSourceId**  
Optional explicit native-profile source for decisions; must match decisionRuntime when both are set.

**subscriptionSettingsSchema**  
Validates the optional subscription-mode overrides, each with a default.

**workerModelRequirement**  
Says why a model cannot run on the subscription worker, or undefined when it can.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The policy that Foundry is subscription-only by default: the worker and every decision role run on the logins already on the machine, API-key providers exist only behind the apiTokens opt-in, and the policy decides which login, harness and model each role may use.

## 2. The domain

A fresh install with no settings runs the Claude Code worker on the default Claude login (~/.claude) and every decision role on Claude Haiku 5.5 through the same login. resolveSubscriptionPolicy resolves the mode at startup and checks the login locations: in subscription mode no API provider is constructed, and there is no paid fallback, no automatic retry and no model substitution. `apiTokens: true` is the only opt-in to API-key providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, gateways, Kingdom bindings) and cannot be combined with `subscriptionOnly`. `defaults.provider` picks the worker harness (`claude-code`, or `codex` on the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login); `defaults.nativeAuthenticationId` and `subscriptionOnly.decisionSourceId` name explicit native-profile sources for the worker and the decisions (credential references, never tokens; the decision source must match the decision runtime). The worker and decisions may share one login as shared holders; gateways, Kingdom bindings and per-thread authentication selections cannot be mixed in. subscriptionSettingsSchema validates the optional overrides with their defaults.

Models: main threads run only on the five labs in MAIN_THREAD_LABS (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta, xAI), checked by assertMainThreadLabs; a Codex worker must be a ChatGPT login and runs on its own Foundry-private CODEX_HOME. An executor, project or thread may choose any model the subscription worker runs (workerModelRequirement says why one cannot). Decision roles are different: cheap models decide, capable models work, so every enabled non-executor agent saved with another provider or model is routed to the decision profile at startup, and settings that cannot be enforced (an executor on another provider, decision agents with tools or temperature overrides, learning.review model overrides) are refused. Local profile references are not Kingdom capacity grants, and startup makes no model calls unless FOUNDRY_STARTUP_SELF_TEST=1.

Not here: how decisions actually run (primed hosts, the scheduler, budgets, deadlines, the decision runtime and decision model settings, receipts) is the `decision-hosts` region; Wardens held inside the thread's own Claude process are `in-session-wardens`; login profile directories, credential sources, Kingdom-held logins and private files are `logins-secrets`; the model registry and API-key providers themselves are `models-providers`; launching the worker session is `native-sessions`; Kingdom capacity grants are `kingdom`; the settings file and its patch semantics are `settings-runtime`.

| Flow role | Model Tier | Examples | Why |

**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § (preface) (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

### Subscription-only Foundry

Foundry runs subscription-only by default. A fresh install, with no settings at all, runs the Claude Code worker and Foundry's decisions from the logins already on the machine:

- **Worker:** Claude Code, using the default Claude login (`~/.claude`, selected by leaving `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` unset). Set `defaults.provider` to `codex` (for example with `defaults.model: "gpt-6-astra"`) to run main threads on Codex instead, on the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login (`~/.codex`).
- **Decisions:** Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`) through the same Claude login (`~/.claude`), on primed Claude Code sessions. Classifiers, routers, the Cartographer, the Librarian, Wardens (advise, guard and review), configured experts and thread naming all use this decision profile. The runtime is a setting: `subscriptionOnly.decisionRuntime: "codex"` runs decisions on the Codex CLI's ChatGPT login (`~/.codex`) with GPT-6 Luna instead.

No API provider is constructed in this mode. There is no paid fallback, no automatic retry and no model substitution. API-key providers need an explicit opt-in.

<!-- unit doc:docs/subscription-decisions.md#settings -->
**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § Settings (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

#### Settings

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiTokens` | absent (`false`) | `true` opts in to API-key providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, gateways, Kingdom bindings) and the API decision provider, Anthropic Haiku 5.5 by default, which requires `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. It cannot be combined with `subscriptionOnly`. |
| `defaults.provider` | `claude-code` | The main-thread worker. Without API tokens it is a subscription harness: `claude-code` or `codex`. |
| `defaults.nativeAuthenticationId` | absent: `~/.claude` or `~/.codex` | Optional explicit `native-profile` source for the worker; its runtime matches the worker. |
| `defaults.classifierProvider` / `classifierModel` | `subscription-decisions` / `claude-haiku-5-5` | New configurations record the decision profile here; `classifierModel` selects the decision model. A model registered only on the other runtime is refused rather than substituted. |
| `subscriptionOnly.decisionRuntime` | `claude` | Decision runtime when no explicit source is named: `claude` (`~/.claude`) or `codex` (`~/.codex`). `claude-in-session` runs Claude decisions too, but holds each thread's Wardens as subagents inside the thread's own Claude Code process (below); it needs the Claude Code worker. |
| `subscriptionOnly.decisionSourceId` | absent: the runtime's default login | Optional explicit `native-profile` source for decisions. It must match `decisionRuntime` when both are set. |
| `subscriptionOnly.model` | `claude-haiku-5-5` for Claude, `gpt-5.6-luna` for Codex (a ChatGPT login on an older Codex CLI, 0.153.4, is refused `gpt-6-luna`) | Decision model; overrides `classifierModel`. Heavier roles can name `claude-opus-5-5` or `claude-fable-5-1`. |
| `subscriptionOnly.expectedObservedModel` | the requested model | Claude decision profiles only: the id the CLI must report serving (for example the full id behind an alias). Codex does not acknowledge a different model. |
| `subscriptionOnly.directory` | `<project>/.foundry/decision-receipts` | Private (0700) receipt directory. The default is created at startup; an explicit directory must already exist and be private. |
| `subscriptionOnly.maxCalls` | `10000` | Finite decision attempt budget for this Foundry process, including failed admitted attempts. It does not renew automatically. |
| `subscriptionOnly.maxConcurrent` | `16` | Decisions running at once across all threads: Claude CLI processes (~130–230 MB each), or concurrent turns on the one warm Codex process. Sized for a full chorus: every Warden is asked on every user message, and every guard-triggered Warden on every action. |
| (primed keys) | `2 × Wardens + 8`, at least 16 | Claude decision roles kept primed, sized at startup from the largest chorus any project runs (its region Wardens; an advice and a review key each). Each holds a spare CLI process (~130–230 MB): 25 Wardens is about 50 processes and 10 GB. An evicted key re-primes cold (5–8 s). Not a setting. |
| `subscriptionOnly.maxQueued` | `512` | Waiting decisions across all threads (up to 1024). |
| `subscriptionOnly.maxQueuedPerThread` | `256` | Waiting decisions per logical thread: deep enough that a burst of guards never refuses admission. |
| `subscriptionOnly.effort` | `low` | Decision reasoning effort (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`; Haiku 5.5 accepts `low` to `high`). The model default, `medium`, adds latency per decision. |
| `subscriptionOnly.hedgeAfterMs` | `4000` for Codex | A decision still running after this long starts the same input on a second branch; the first to finish wins (500 to 30000). |
| `subscriptionOnly.callTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-decision deadline including queue and preflight time (100 to 30000). |

Explicit profile sources are credential references in `nativeAuthentication`, never tokens:

```json
{
  "nativeAuthentication": [
    { "id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "integrationId": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
      "runtime": "codex", "mode": "native-profile", "profileDirectory": "/private/path/decisions" }
  ],
  "subscriptionOnly": { "decisionSourceId": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" }
}
```

An explicit profile directory must be an owned private (0700) directory with private files. The default login locations are referenced in place: they must be owned, real directories whose credential files (`auth.json`, `.credentials.json`) are private, but Foundry does not require or change their mode. The worker and the decisions may share one login: both are shared holders of it, like the user's own concurrent CLI sessions. Gateways, Kingdom bindings and per-thread authentication selections cannot be mixed into subscription mode.

<!-- unit doc:docs/subscription-decisions.md#main-threads -->
**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § Main threads (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

#### Main threads

Main threads (the default worker and every enabled executor) run on models from five labs: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta and xAI (`MAIN_THREAD_LABS` in the core model registry). Other labs, gateways and local hosts are refused as main threads in every mode. How each lab runs:

| Lab | Subscription (default) | With `apiTokens: true` |
|---|---|---|
| Anthropic | `claude-code` on the Claude login | also `anthropic` (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) |
| OpenAI | `codex` on the Codex ChatGPT login | also `openai` (`OPENAI_API_KEY`) |
| Google | no harness yet (agent-session's ACP transport for Gemini CLI is a stub) | `gemini` (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) |
| Meta | no harness yet | `meta` (`MODEL_API_KEY`) |
| xAI | no harness yet | `xai` (`XAI_API_KEY`) |

A refused main thread names what it needs, in the settings API, the viewer's Defaults editor and setup.

A Codex worker is checked with `codex login status` and must be a ChatGPT login; an API-key login is refused. It shares the Codex login with Codex decisions (both are shared holders, so they may use the same `~/.codex`) and runs on its own Foundry-private `CODEX_HOME` (`.foundry/runtime-profiles/<source id>/codex-home`, kept across restarts so sessions resume) that links the profile's `auth.json`. None of the user's Codex config, instructions or MCP servers apply to it, and it runs with Codex's own sandbox and approvals off, like the Claude worker's bypass mode.

<!-- unit doc:docs/subscription-decisions.md#existing-settings -->
**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § Existing settings (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

#### Existing settings

Subscription mode runs every enabled non-executor agent on the decision profile. An agent saved with another provider or model (for example a classifier on `gemini` or a Librarian on `claude-code`) is routed to `subscription-decisions` at startup; the startup log lists each routed agent. The saved settings file is not rewritten. Settings that cannot be enforced are refused rather than routed: a worker that is not a subscription harness, an executor on another provider, a main-thread model the worker does not run, decision agents with tools, thinking, cache or non-zero temperature overrides, and `learning.review` provider/model overrides.

The default model is only the default. An executor (`agents[id].model`), a project (`projects[id].defaults.model`) and a thread (the launch settings a host or the viewer chooses) may each run any model the subscription worker runs, as its registry entry lists them (`workerModelRequirement`); a model of another provider is refused. Decision roles are different: every decision runs on one shared primed host per runtime, which launches with the decision model and refuses a call naming any other, so a decision agent's own model is routed to the decision model rather than honoured.

<!-- unit doc:docs/subscription-decisions.md#integration-limits -->
**Source:** `docs/subscription-decisions.md` § Integration limits (in "Subscription-only Foundry")

#### Integration limits

Local profile references are not Kingdom capacity grants. A project execution contract must independently authorize worker and decision roles, purposes, model identities, aggregate budgets, deadlines and generation revocation. Startup makes no model calls unless `FOUNDRY_STARTUP_SELF_TEST=1` is set; in subscription mode that self-test consumes a decision allowance.

<!-- unit doc:CLAUDE.md#model-routing -->
**Source:** `CLAUDE.md` § Model Routing (in "Foundry")

#### Model Routing

**Cheap models for decisions, capable models for work.** Classifiers, routers, the Cartographer, the Librarian and Wardens (advise, guard and review) run on Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`). Heavier reasoning roles use Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) or Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`). Only the Artificer uses a capable model by default.

Foundry is subscription-only by default and all Claude for now (2026-10-11): the Artificer runs on the Claude Code login (`~/.claude`) (Codex, with `defaults.provider: "codex"`, is a setting), and every decision role runs Claude Haiku 5.5 on primed Claude Code sessions through the same Claude login, with no API provider constructed and no paid fallback. The decision runtime and model are settings (`subscriptionOnly.decisionRuntime`, `subscriptionOnly.model` / `defaults.classifierModel`), so Codex or another lab can run decisions again without code changes. `decisionRuntime: "claude-in-session"` (off by default) holds each thread's Wardens as subagents inside the thread's own Claude Code process (docs/THREAD-TREE.md spec C). API-key providers require `apiTokens: true`; their decision default is Anthropic Haiku 5.5. Main threads run on Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Meta and xAI models only. See [subscription decisions](docs/subscription-decisions.md) for settings, bounds and ownership.
